name: NPI-WCA-BlockAlert
description: A workload identity in scope of CA015 or CA037 was blocked by Conditional Access (AADSTS53003). Security operations triages it as a possible stolen credential or a workload that moved; the application owner is told the same day.
query:
AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
| where tostring(ResultType) == "53003"
| where ServicePrincipalId in ({scope:inScope})
| project TimeGenerated, ServicePrincipalId, AppId, IPAddress, ResultType, ConditionalAccessPolicies
deployment: Reviewed definition only: deploy it as a log search alert rule on the Log Analytics workspace that receives the service principal sign-in logs, in its own reviewed change. This code doesn't write to Azure Monitor.
